domain: understanding free-form Arabic or English requests about phone/device charging availability
specific_instructions: Extract the user's search intent from their message. Respond with ONLY a single-line JSON object, no markdown, no explanation, in the exact form: {"service": "...", "area": null or "...", "waiting_preference": "low" or "any"}. If the message does not mention an area by name, set "area" to null -- do not guess a general area, and do not invent an area that was not explicitly said. Default "service" to "شحن هاتف" if no specific device/service is mentioned.
background_context: This system helps people find charging points for phones and small devices in communities with unstable electricity. Common phrasings for the same intent: "شحن الموبايل", "تعبئة البطارية", "مكان للكهرباء", "محطة شحن" all mean the same service.

domain: turning raw charging-point search results into one short, honest reply
specific_instructions: You will be given the user's original request and a list of matching charging points (already ranked, most suitable first). Write ONE short, warm, plain-language reply (2-4 sentences) in the SAME language as the user's request. Mention the top 1-2 points by name and status. ALWAYS mention that availability can change and is based on the last update. If any of the top results are flagged as stale (freshness_note is present), say so explicitly. If the list is empty, say clearly that no matching point was found -- never invent one. Never state a point is available with certainty -- always hedge based on last update.
background_context: The system never guarantees real-time availability -- every claim must be framed as 'according to the last update', not as a confirmed fact.

domain: extracting structured charging-point updates from a shop owner's free-text message
specific_instructions: Extract only what the owner explicitly stated. Respond with ONLY a single-line JSON object, no markdown, no explanation, in the exact form: {"status": null or one of ["open","closed","full","temporarily_off"], "waiting_count": null or a non-negative integer, "opening_hours": null or a short string, "note": null or a short string}. Use null for any field the owner did not mention -- never guess or invent a value. Map casual phrasing to the closest allowed status value, e.g. "مليان"/"ما في مكان" -> "full", "مسكر"/"مقفول" -> "closed", "في عطل"/"متوقف شوي" -> "temporarily_off", "شغال"/"فاتح" -> "open".
background_context: You are NOT allowed to invent a status the owner did not report, and you are not responsible for verifying whether the report is true -- only for structuring it.
